title: Euro Step and Jump-Stop Finishing
description: Learn two footwork finishes around a defender's spot: the jump stop to stay under control and the euro step to change direction and finish over a defender.

content.objective: Change direction with the feet at the rim without travelling, finishing with either hand around a defender's space.
content.setup: A cone marks a defender on each side of the lane, two steps from the rim. Players line up at the top of the key, each with a ball or sharing two balls.
instructions: Dribble at the cone on the right, take the last dribble and step wide with the right foot.
Step across with the left foot in the opposite direction of the first step and finish with the left hand.
Repeat from the other side using the left foot first, finishing with the right hand.
Add a jump stop instead of the euro step on the third attempt: land on two feet, pivot and finish.
Change sides every attempt and count makes over one minute.
coachingPoints: Long first step to the side, then a long second step back the other way.
Take the last dribble at the top of the first step; do not carry the ball.
Keep the ball protected on the side away from the cone.
Land balanced and finish softly with a high release.
commonMistakes: Travelling by taking three steps after gathering the ball.
Making the first step too short so there is no change of direction.
Losing the ball control on the gather.
content.safety: Keep cones away from the landing area; wait behind the baseline while another player finishes.
progressions: Replace the cones with a live defender offering light contact.
regressions: Walk through the footwork without the ball, then with the ball at half speed.
variations: Finish with a reverse layup on the second attempt.
